title: Evidence Facet -- evidence.yaml
description: SDD-R011 §16, SDD-R012 §13. Supports the engineering assertions this object makes. Distinct from Authority (where the truth originates) and Provenance (who authored/reviewed this record). Free-text `reference` until Source Object EKOs exist (SDD-R012 §7) -- see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md.

reference.description: Free text identifying the specific source (e.g. "IEC 60115").

evidence_source_object.description: Object ID of a Source Object EKO, once one exists for this reference. Null for this work package.
